body.text: Criteria v1 recorded as r0003 before simulation judgments. Initial CPU simulation uses actual 7-joint arm and supplied Wuji meshes with MuJoCo contact, 8-iteration differential IK and delayed commands. Reset palm chosen as package start (constant 1.5-s ramp) to keep starts visible and avoid motion during the hold-start check; the recommended overhead ramp lags by 32 mm in this articulated model. FK error 0.036 mm; initial supported hold and contract log checks pass. Teacher approach budget: 90 min for geometric opposed fingertip trajectory tracking, then reassess using actual contact/rotation results.

First exploratory teacher rollout, seed 0: no object contact before torque_halt at 4.63 s. I inspected top/right harness renders: the unused outstretched middle/ring/pinky fingers reach the table while the intended thumb-index pinch is still misaligned. Measured opposed_s=0 and max arm external torque 62.8 Nm. Curl unused digits and assess reachable approach choices; the geometric fingertip fit alone did not establish feasibility. 64/64 randomized supported hold starts passed, with no stops; sensor/contract consistency also passed on the saved hold episode.

Coupled contact IK gives sub-mm fingertip matches for seed 0 and ~1.5 mm for seed 5, but physical rollout 0 holds only 0.85 s, rises 25.6 mm, then pivots passively by 30.4 deg and drops; it does not meet the active-turn criterion. Render at 10 s confirms a thumb-index pinch. The teacher turn planner rotates the wrist 84.5 deg, so it needs an explicit wrist-rotation bound. Seed 5 hits the table during descent. Slow approach/settling, proper opposed normal forces, and mechanical joint-stop stiffness will be tested; default MuJoCo joint stops yielded 24–38 mrad past limits under contact, beyond the 20 mrad allowance.

Simulation validation caught a modeling error before registration: enabling all supplied hand convex hulls against one another caused 0/64 open holds to stay within hardware limits (the vendor hulls overlap around adjacent motor housings). The earlier 64/64 result applied to object contacts without full hand self collision and is not evidence for the failed variant. Replace inter-finger self contacts with phalange-core capsules, preserve full supplied hulls against objects, explicitly document the approximation, and repeat the supported-start and contract checks before freezing the evaluator.
